## 🎯 Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or a new cloud compute archetype? A clear and concise description of what the challenge is.

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or capability you would like to see implemented.

## 🏛️ Architectural Tier Mapping (5-Tier Framework)
Which StackVend tiers would this capability touch?
- [ ] **Tier 1: Specification Ingestion & Prompt Layer** (`apps/spec-ingestion`, prompt engineering)
- [ ] **Tier 2: Agent Swarm Architecture** (`apps/orchestrator-gateway/`, persona system prompts, tool schemas)
- [ ] **Tier 3: Platform Compiler & Sanitizer Pipeline** (`apps/project-vending`, AST validators)
- [ ] **Tier 4: Golden Modules & IaC Providers** (`infra/modules/`, OpenTofu composite bundles)
- [ ] **Tier 5: Runtime Verification & MCP Tool Servers** (`mcp-servers/*`, Cloud Run tools)

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, third-party tools, or workarounds you've evaluated.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, Google Cloud service documentation links, or architectural diagrams.
